subject: Getting type objects as patterns on gm object

messages.author: a2161d5899b943a4
messages.subject: Getting type objects as patterns on gm object
parts:
Hi 

This is probably a very simple question, I had to do some basic scripts after calculation to get the patterns in my output results. However just wanted to ask if there is a simple way to write gm object (i.e after calculating for DMR), to get "type" or otherwise known as "pattern" i.e. type being Hypo or Hyper methylated in the 8th columns.

The current output has the  following "chr","start","end","strand","pvalue","qvalue","meth.diff"
What I would like to see is this "chr","start","end","strand","pvalue","qvalue","meth.diff", "type"

Thanks

Uma

messages.author: a2161d5899b943a4
messages.subject: Re: Getting type objects as patterns on gm object
parts:
If somebody is interested in this - I just do the following. Please note I am looping through the files in the directory

this.file <- filename[i]

query <- read.csv(file.names[i]) #This is methylKit "myDiff25p" generated file
query <- transform(query, pattern= ifelse(query$meth.diff > 0.25, "Hypermethylation DMR", "Hypomethylation DMR"))
write.csv(query, paste(this.file"_pattern.csv"))
